ns2:course.label: Ethical & Professional Issues
ns2:course.description: Ethics for the computing profession. Ethical decision-making; licensing; intellectual property, freedom of information, and privacy. Credit is not given for both CS 210 and either CS 211 or ECE 316. Prerequisite: CS 225. Junior standing required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both CS 210 and either CS 211 or ECE 316. Prerequisite: CS 225. Junior standing required.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Computer Science major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to CS and blended CS majors students.
